typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		CUSIP as string,
		ProductType3 as string,
		ProductType1 as string,
		ADPNumber as string,
		SourceSystemName as string,
		ClientNum as string,
		ActualDate as timestamp,
		SourcePositionId as string,
		ProductAccountingCode as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		CUSIP as string,
		ProductType3 as string,
		ProductType1 as string,
		ADPNumber as string,
		SourceSystemName as string,
		ClientNum as long,
		ActualDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SourcePositionId as string,
		ProductAccountingCode as long
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CUSIP,
		ProductType3,
		ProductType1,
		ADPNumber,
		SourceSystemName,
		ClientNum,
		ActualDate,
		SourcePositionId,
		ProductAccountingCode),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
